The optimized exponential bound is not claimed to be the exact
tail probability at every threshold.
request.text:
Within the exponential method the first bound cannot be improved: for
independent Bernoulli variables of common mean \(p\), the source's
binomial case (2.5), the minimum over \(h>0\) of the right side of its
(1.7), \(e^{-hnt}Ee^{hS_n}\), equals \(e^{-nD(p+t\Vert p)}\) and is
attained exactly at \(h=\lambda_*\); so (2.1) is the best bound that
minimizing (1.7) over \(h\) can give under these hypotheses
\cite[p.~15]{Hoeffding1963BoundedSums}. The source distinguishes this
from the least upper bound of the probability depending only on \(t\),
\(n\), the ranges and \(p\) \cite[p.~14 and n.~3]{Hoeffding1963BoundedSums}.
Both statements, with \(n=1\) as a case where the least upper bound
\(p/(p+t)\) is strictly smaller, are proved as
\cref{thm:p15-w02b-p15-063-exponential-optimality}.

At the optimizing \(\lambda_*\) from the common-range proof,

request.text:
The source compares its bounds with the normal-model value
\(e^{-nt^2/(2\sigma^2)}\) of its (2.16), which is the minimum over \(h\)
of (1.7) when \(\overline X\) is normal, with \(\sigma^2\) the average
variance: the second bound of \cref{thm:p15-conc-common-range} with
\(p\geq1/2\) equals that value in the binomial case, and the first bound of
\cref{thm:p15-conc-unequal-ranges}, at the threshold \(nt\) for \(S_n\),
equals it when every \(X_i\) takes \(a_i\) and \(b_i\) with probability
\(1/2\) each \cite[p.~17]{Hoeffding1963BoundedSums}. Against the
Chebyshev bounds (1.5)--(1.6), the source states that its bounds are
better except for small \(t\) or small \(n\), and that for fixed \(t\)
they decrease exponentially in \(n\) \cite[p.~14]{Hoeffding1963BoundedSums}.
These coincidences, the inequalities they are equality cases of, the
exact thresholds in \(nt^2\) at which the exponential bounds fall below
the one-sided and two-sided Chebyshev values, and the Mills-ratio
comparison are stated and proved as
\cref{thm:p15-w02b-p15-063-chebyshev-comparison,thm:p15-w02b-p15-063-normal-benchmark}.
